_source: Captured 2026-06-02 from a maintainer S7 Flashdry, EMPTY state, during a full→empty transition test (home-assistant_tineco log 18-50). gci payload values are real; device metadata matches the known S7 Flashdry shape. PII (did/email/tokens) scrubbed.
_regression_note: Real full→empty transition: water present = wp=238,e2=0 (full); empty/insufficient = wp=239,e2=64 (this fixture). The definitive empty signal is e2 bit 64, corroborated by wp flipping 238→239. wp=238 is the HAS-WATER value, NOT an empty sentinel — an earlier build wrongly mapped 238/239/240→empty and got stuck on empty. The fresh water tank sensor must report 'empty' here.
